defs.doc:
Seconds since the user's previous event of the type and of any type, for
events sorted by (user, ts), NaN where there was none.
One pass per user, one instant at a time; the instant's rows are read before
they become the latest events.
NaN for "never" keeps a missing history apart from a gap of zero seconds.
user  the entity key, sorted ascending
ts  event time, int64 nanoseconds, ascending within a user
hit  1 on events of the type asked about, else 0
@ caf3bd02
defs.intent: Seconds since the user's previous event of the type and of any type, for events sorted by (user, ts), NaN where there was none.

steps.text: the instant's rows see the events before it
an event of the type at this instant becomes the latest

loops.head: for k from i to same
